item.title: Matt Mescia taking over as Dracut High’s football coach
item.description: DRACUT — When one door closes, another door opens. That’s the case with the Dracut High football program. After head coach Trevor Knight announced his resignation following a short but impactful two seasons, his former college teammate, Matt Mescia, was recently named his replacement, athletic director Tom DiGeronimo announced. item.title: Trahan, McGovern, Clark, Pressley join Markey in boycotting State of the Union address
item.description: Several members of the Massachusetts federal delegation say they will not attend the State of the Union address Tuesday night, joining Sen. Ed Markey (D-MA) in boycotting the event in protest against President Trump.

item.title: The Five Minute Read
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication. Submitted photographs should be at least 300 KB in JPG format.
